items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I met him up at the Vermont Jazz Summer Workshop one year

ctx.x: Oh, he’s one of the greatest.

And I like one of the discs Benny Waters told me to get, it was one of his, “Swinging Again.” I really enjoy playing that one. I got a Ray Brown “Bass Face.” There’s another vocalist, Larry Brown, “Swing Bean.” He’s not really that much known. I met him up at the Vermont Jazz Summer Workshop one year, but the musicians on the disc are just so wonderful to listen to. So then again a lot of them are just hearing something I like and then going out and buying that, rather than for the artist itself. I just picked up…
Have you had a chance to record yourself?
